The plate is about 400 px across in the image. I'm assuming it is a dinner plate of roughly 26 cm, which gives about 15 px per cm.

The omelette is about 90 px wide and 250 px long, so roughly 6 cm by 16 cm. It looks folded and about 2.5 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 6 × 16 × 2.5 × 0.7 (shape factor) ≈ 170 cm³. Egg omelette is fairly dense, but it has some air in it, so I'm using about 0.8 g/cm³. That comes to roughly 135 g.

There is a small red fleck, probably pepper or tomato. It is too small to count as a separate item.
